summary.zh: 只读分析参考 PPT 的结构、主题和版式节奏
summary.en: Read-only analysis of a reference deck's structure and theme

description.zh: 提取参考演示文稿的页数、尺寸、主题色、字体、版式节奏和占位符，整理成可复用的模板目录，也能检查文件内部的 XML 与关系是否完整，原文和素材始终保持只读。适合沿用现有风格制作新 PPT。使用内置检查脚本前需安装 defusedxml。
description.en: Extracts slide count, size, theme colors, fonts, layout rhythm, and placeholders into a template catalog, and can check OOXML relationships. The source deck stays read-only. Install defusedxml to use the bundled inspection scripts.
